target: Sea Around Us Sea of Okhotsk LME 052
target_area_provenance: Reused permitted shared LME052 geographic boundary calculation; no new source-model area measurement.
source_domain_evidence: Primary abstract printed143/PDF1 estimates production for the entire Sea of Okhotsk. Methods printed145/PDF3 define epipelagic plankton sampling at 0–200 m, surface to bottom where depth is below 200 m. Figure1 printed146/PDF4 shows widespread 2003–2014 tissue sampling stations.
source_definition: Whole Sea of Okhotsk epipelagic water column, model period 2000–2014.
method: Qualitative whole-sea geographic approximation from explicit source scope, checked against Figure1 coastlines and sampling spread. LME boundary is the intended whole-sea horizontal-domain proxy; station dots are not a study-boundary polygon.
B_denominator: Intended whole-sea model horizontal area approximated by target LME052
limitation: Approximately 100 percent A and B describe the intended whole-sea domain, not measured author-GIS overlap or uniformly sampled coverage. Figure1 does not establish precise coastal/southern limits. Epipelagic scope excludes benthic trophic compartments even when horizontal geographic overlap is high.
